data.one_liner: Mediation adapter enabling Mintegral ads through the google_mobile_ads plugin.
data.what_it_does: The package bridges Flutter code to the Mintegral ad network via Google Mobile Ads. It forwards ad requests and handles callbacks on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need Mintegral mediation in a Flutter app
You already use google_mobile_ads for other ad formats
You target both Android and iOS
avoid_when: You only need a single ad network without mediation
strengths: Integrates directly with Google Mobile Ads
Supports latest Mintegral adapter versions for Android and iOS
Works on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Only works for Mintegral, not other networks
Requires native SDK setup and platform configuration
data.setup_notes: Add the Mintegral SDK adapters to Android and iOS projects, update AndroidManifest and Info.plist with required permissions and IDs, ensure google_mobile_ads version compatibility, and run flutter pub get.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core ad SDK without mediation, simpler if you only need Google ads

alternatives.name: applovin_max
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides its own mediation layer for multiple networks, including Mintegral
